description: Half of a phaser: two allpass stages modelled on a light-dependent resistor, wrapped in a feedback loop and swept by a control voltage

params.text: Reshapes the control voltage before it drives the light-dependent resistor model, raising it to a power between a half and two so the sweep leans to one end; at the centre it passes through unshaped
Sets how much of the output is fed back into the two allpass stages, 0 to 0.95

inputs.text: Sweeps the phaser. Five volts is the top of the range and minus five volts the bottom, and a bipolar LFO here is what makes the usual phaser sound.

outputs.text: The phased audio, soft-clipped through a hyperbolic tangent so it cannot leave the range -5V to 5V

notes: the control voltage input is what sweeps this module; with nothing patched there the filter stands at one frequency and the sound does not move.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only
